clips.title: The story
paras: Hornizz Brimbuzzle thinks there is money in the ghosts of the Valley of Bones. He figures the Magram centaurs would pay plenty for ghost energy, and he gives you a crate of ghost magnets to draw the spirits out.

Hornizz points you southeast, to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. It sounds frightening, he admits, but surely it is scarier still for the Magram. He is sure that ghost energy captured there would be worth plenty to those centaurs.

He hands you a crate of ghost magnets. Set down between the two huge skeletons in the valley, known as the Dead Goliaths, a magnet lures the ghosts toward it. From them you take ghost-o-plasm, which is what Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He wants eight ghost-o-plasms brought back to him, along with the crate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's a valley to the southeast, the Valley of Bones, haunted by Magram ghosts. Sounds scary, doesn't it? Well think how scary it is to the Magram! If we captured ghost energy from that place, I bet it'd be worth plenty to those centaurs.

Here, take this crate of ghost magnets. If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it. Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm--that's what we'll sell to the Magram.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There it is! Looks like you got some of it on you too. Kinda slimey, eh?
Well, thanks a lot for all the trouble, friend. This stuff will be worth a fortune... If I can convince the centaurs what it is!
